title: Tonal dock lacked a real content underlay
observed: The preceding shell kept bottomNavigationBar outside the body and painted a solid tint.
impact: Calling this glass would overstate the material behavior.
proposal: Extend the body and sample real scrolling content through one clipped modest backdrop filter.
verification: 30 nav/glass tests; targeted inheritance/contrast checks; three shell accessibility/layout cases; six capture cases/eight PNGs; scoped analyzer and format passed. Static pack minimum contrast5.46. No device/FPS claim.

title: Extending content requires protected end-of-list and action geometry
observed: Several root pages used explicit bottom padding, and the fixed Workspace CTA did not consume a shell inset.
impact: A naive body extension would cover final rows and the primary action.
proposal: Consume the measured Scaffold bottom inset inside root scroll space and fixed CTA positioning; hide the dock for the keyboard.
verification: 30 nav/glass tests; targeted inheritance/contrast checks; three shell accessibility/layout cases; six capture cases/eight PNGs; scoped analyzer and format passed. Static pack minimum contrast5.46. No device/FPS claim.

title: Translucent backdrop can reduce muted foreground contrast
observed: Muted and primary colors, then some alternate pack onSurface colors, failed worst-case compositing against contrasting backdrop samples.
impact: Small navigation labels could fall below readable contrast over scrolled content.
proposal: Use local neutral foreground and verify the actual translucent fill/indicator across supported static packs; preserve an opaque filter-free accessibility fallback.
verification: 30 nav/glass tests; targeted inheritance/contrast checks; three shell accessibility/layout cases; six capture cases/eight PNGs; scoped analyzer and format passed. Static pack minimum contrast5.46. No device/FPS claim.

title: Native material terminology needs precise provenance
observed: The app renders through Flutter; no Android OS cross-window or Compose glass API is used.
impact: A platform-native claim would misrepresent the implementation.
proposal: Document this as real in-app Flutter GPU glass on Android using supported framework APIs.
verification: 30 nav/glass tests; targeted inheritance/contrast checks; three shell accessibility/layout cases; six capture cases/eight PNGs; scoped analyzer and format passed. Static pack minimum contrast5.46. No device/FPS claim.
